Shone syndrome: The combination of mitral stenosis, aortic stenosis, and coarctation of the aorta is consistent with Shone syndrome, a rare congenital heart defect.
Hypoplastic left heart syndrome: The presence of mitral stenosis, aortic stenosis, and coarctation of the aorta could also be indicative of hypoplastic left heart syndrome, although the absence of other characteristic features such as left ventricular hypoplasia makes this diagnosis less likely.
